changelog:
Initial release of newsletter-audience-intelligence skill.

- Transforms subscriber, survey, reply, click, and source data into actionable audience insights for newsletters.
- Compares audience segments on engagement, sponsor fit, and quality using only available, explicit data.
- Provides sponsor-ready proof points, risk flags, and clear separation of known vs. missing data.
- Offers a structured workflow and output format for consistent reporting.
- Includes recommendations for improved data collection and integration with connected workspaces.
- Strong guardrails to avoid overstating metrics or inferring unsupported demographic details.
